help.iterations: Number of measurement loops per size/setup. Higher = more stable median.
help.warmup_iterations: Loops run before measurement to warm up instruction/data caches.
help.slave_thread_id: CPU core index to pin the benchmark thread to. Isolates noise.
help.sizes: Explicit list of vector sizes. If set, overrides size_region.
help.size_region: [min, max] range for automatic logarithmic size sampling.
help.unroll_factors: Template unroll factors to compile. e.g. [1, 2, 4].
help.data_range_min: Minimum value for random data generation.
help.data_range_max: Maximum value for random data generation.
help.enable_papi: Collect hardware counters (FLOPS, L2 misses, etc) via PAPI.
